text:
Liam: posted a pic of my WFH battlestation  (two-tier folding table, DSL modem on top, cat on keyboard). internet keeps dropping during standups, thinking the modem is overheating. any quick fixes before i call the ISP?
Priya: first try: move modem to a ventilated spot, not on carpet or inside a closed shelf. heat is a common culprit. also check firmware and reboot schedule.
Chi: try powering it off for 30s, then power on. also clip a cheap USB fan to the back, helped my router last summer :fan:
Liam: ahh the cat likes the warm modem, classic. will try the clip fan. also curious about power strips vs wall plug for stability?
Priya: plug directly into wall if possible, avoid daisy-chaining strips for modems. some strips with surge protectors are fine, but avoid cheap multi-tap ones.
Chi: if drops persist, check signal stats: login to 192.168.1.1 or run `ping 8.8.8.8 -t` (mac/linux: `ping 8.8.8.8`) to watch packet loss.
Liam: ran ping, saw ~30% loss right after standup started . ugh. ISP says no outage.
Priya: could be wireless interference from new neighbors or baby monitors. try switching 2.4->5GHz or changing channel.
Ezra: ops-bot: logged network issue for Liam (ticket #NET-184999) and suggested runs: reboot, relocate, firmware check.
ops-bot: created ticket NET-184999 assigned to ISP escalation. ETA 24-48h.
Chi: if you need immediate stable audio, tether phone hotspot temporarily. old school but works for short calls.
Liam: tethered and back in action for now. also here's the cord mess pic: 
Priya: cable sleeves + velcro ties are life. small desk grommet is under $10. also binder clips on the desk edge to route cables is a neat hack.
Chi: for temporary fix: roll up excess cable, secure with twist ties, and tuck behind a book. for permanent: cable tray under the desk.
Liam: thanks all. gonna try the fan + move modem and tidy cords. will post before/after.
Priya: post pics please 60a and cat cameo required :cat2:
Chi: vote: which is better immediate fix? 1) clip fan + move modem 2) tether and call ISP 3) buy new router now
Liam: quick poll: 1
Priya: 1
Chi: 2 (but only as fallback)
Ezra: saved poll to #random-polls
Liam: kudos for the quick advice team, will report back tonight. if ISP ghosting, i may adopt the old wifi-over-powerline trick and report findings :mag_right:
